name: News panel shows at least three news cards
description: The related news section should show at least 3 distinct news cards per match to provide meaningful coverage.

planSteps.description: Click on a knockout bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Click the News or Related News tab
Scroll through the news panel to see all news cards
Verify the news panel contains at least 3 distinct news card entries. Each card should appear as a separate visual unit with distinct content. Fewer than 3 cards fails this test.
